build_qwen2_5_vl_processor: build a Qwen2.5-VL processor to tokenize text and process images and videos for the model
create_vision_config: create a Qwen2_5_VLVisionConfig to set vision model hyperparameters like depth, hidden size, and patch size
create_model_config: create a Qwen2_5_VLConfig to configure the model with vocab size, hidden size, and attention heads
review_vision_model_forward: review the Qwen2_5VisionModel forward pass that applies patch embeddings, rotary position embeddings, and vision blocks
refactor_position_ids: refactor the get_position_ids method to compute 3D M-RoPE position IDs for mixed vision and text segments
